content.short: TaskOn is a Web3 task and quest platform on Mantle enabling projects to run reward campaigns and users to earn by completing on-chain tasks.
content.description: TaskOn is a decentralized task and campaign platform that connects Web3 projects with active community members through structured reward programs. Projects create campaigns with on-chain and off-chain tasks  such as bridging assets, swapping tokens, following social accounts, or testing features  and TaskOn verifies completion and distributes rewards automatically. The platform has become a popular marketing and user acquisition tool for projects launching on Mantle, enabling targeted community growth through performance-based incentives.
content.meta: TaskOn is a Web3 quest and reward campaign platform for community growth in the Mantle ecosystem. Discover TaskOn on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
